screen: View Lead (also Update Inquiry, bookings, trips)
title: Pickup and drop time shown as 12:00 AM instead of the time submitted in User-Web
record: PNR SOQS555799 / LD-353 / Inquiry 944 (User-Web TC-07, submitted 9:00 AM)
pre: Inquiry submitted from User-Web with pickup time 9:00 AM on 20/11/2026
steps: Read Inquiry Information > Pickup Time / Drop Time and Journey 1 > Pickup Time
expected: Pickup Time 9:00 AM (as submitted); Drop time derived from the 8/9 hour package
actual: Pickup Time 12:00 AM, Drop Time 12:00 AM (lead header and Journey 1)
description: The customer-selected pickup time is lost when the inquiry becomes a lead; the same 12:00 AM value then flows to the quote, booking and trip records (also seen for LD-341 / TP-111 in run 20261112). Operations would dispatch at the wrong time.

title: Lead list shows Stage and Expected Value as N/A for an inquiry lead with a costing
pre: Lead created from a User-Web inquiry
steps: Read STAGE and EXPECTED VALUE columns
expected: Expected Value reflects the inquiry cost (Rs 8,300) or a stage is set; or the business rule is documented
actual: STAGE N/A, EXPECTED VALUE N/A while View Lead shows Total Costing Rs 8,300
description: Inquiry-originated leads carry no stage/value in the list, so the pipeline value columns are empty for all such leads (manually created LD-357 shows Prospecting / Rs 5,000). Clarify whether this is intended.

title: View Lead modal has no visible Close control
expected: A visible Close (X) or Close button
actual: Only a "Send To Inquiry" button; the modal closes only with Escape or by clicking outside
description: Users without keyboard habits have no obvious way to dismiss the details modal other than the forward action button.

title: Assign lead: "No sales employees found", lead cannot be assigned
expected: List of sales employees to assign
actual: "No sales employees found"; only placeholder "Select Employee"; Assign disabled
description: Either no employee has the sales role in Preprod (test-data gap) or the employee query fails. Needs clarification; blocks LM-09.

title: Inquiry PNR is not searchable in Lead, Inquiry or Booking lists
expected: The lead with that PNR is found (PNR is the customer-facing reference)
actual: "No data available"; PNR only visible inside View Lead
description: Support staff receiving a PNR from a customer cannot locate the lead/inquiry/booking without already knowing the Lead ID (same in Inquiry and Booking search, run 20261112).

screen: Update Inquiry > Enter Number of Pax's
title: Pax accepts blank, 0, negative, decimal, text and values above vehicle capacity; blank/0 are saved
steps: Lead Management > Search Lead Info "LD-353" > menu > Send To Inquiry (opens Update Inquiry)
Clear "Enter Number of Pax's" (or type 0 / -1 / 1.5 / 100 / abc)
expected: Validation message; pax must be an integer between 1 and the selected vehicle capacity (16); save blocked
actual: No message for any value; blank and 0 save with "Data updated successfully !" and re-open as an empty Pax field
description: Pax is a plain text input without required/format/range checks, unlike Trip Days (min 1). An inquiry/booking can be confirmed with no passengers or more passengers than seats.

screen: Update Inquiry > Vehicle Costs > Final Quote / Total Approx Cost
title: Total Approx Cost (Final Quote) is not recalculated when cost components change, even after saving
pre: Inquiry open in Update Inquiry; total Rs 8,300
steps: Lead Management > Search Lead Info "LD-353" > menu > Send To Inquiry (opens Update Inquiry)
In Vehicle Costs set ADDITIONAL HR'S = 1 (EXTRA HOUR rate 800)
Re-open the inquiry; also open Inquiry list > View Quote
expected: Final Quote = 7,500 + 800 + 1 x 800 = Rs 9,100 (live and after save)
actual: Final Quote stays Rs 8,300.00; Additional HR's 1.00 is saved. Same for Additional KM 10, Toll 100 (saved), Any Extras 50, Day Bata Days 2 and Fixed Cost 9000 with Apply ticked
description: The quote total ignores edits to every cost component, so revised quotes, bookings and invoices keep the original amount. Mirrors the User-Web defect where the 9 HR inquiry is priced as 8 HR.

title: Arrival and Departure time are read-only, so the wrong 12:00 AM pickup time cannot be corrected
steps: Lead Management > Search Lead Info "LD-353" > menu > Send To Inquiry (opens Update Inquiry)
Click Select Arrival Time / Select Departure Time
expected: Time picker to set the correct pickup/drop time
actual: Fields are read-only and show 12:00 AM
description: Combined with ISS-01 the operator has no way to fix the pickup time before booking/dispatch.

title: Requested hour package from User-Web is not visible in Admin
record: LD-353 / Inquiry 944 (QRY-944) / Quote 1701, form /inquiry-management/update-inquiry/dfb79d89-...; User-Web TC-07 submitted 8 HR and 9 HR variants (LD-352, LD-353)
pre: Two User-Web inquiries differing only by hours
expected: Requested hours (e.g. 9 HR) shown, with Additional HR's pre-filled
actual: Neither screen shows the requested hours; package column fixed at 8 HR/80 KM with Additional HR's 0
description: Admin cannot tell whether the customer asked for 8 or 9 hours, so the extra-hour charge cannot be applied. Business clarification needed on where the hours are stored.

title: Pressing Enter in Trip Description submits the whole quote form
steps: Lead Management > Search Lead Info "LD-353" > menu > Send To Inquiry (opens Update Inquiry)
expected: Enter confirms the description entry only
actual: Form is submitted (Update Quote) and the page navigates to Total Inquiries
description: Accidental saves of half-edited quotes.

title: No unsaved-changes warning when leaving the quote form
steps: Lead Management > Search Lead Info "LD-353" > menu > Send To Inquiry (opens Update Inquiry)
expected: Warning before discarding edits
actual: Leaves silently; edits lost
description: Long quote forms lose edits without notice.

title: Inquiry KPI cards inconsistent with the list (109 vs 8; conversion, pending and quote value 0)
steps: Read KPI cards and the "Showing x of y entries" with no filters
expected: Total Inquiries equals the list total (or the card states its scope); Total Quote Value sums quotes; conversion rate reflects converted inquiries
actual: Total Inquiries 109; list "Showing 1 to 5 of 8 entries"; Conversion Rate 0, Pending Approvals 0, Total Quote Value 0
description: Either the list hides converted inquiries without saying so, or the cards are not computed. Needs business clarification of each card definition.

title: Grammar: "Are you sure want to convert this inquiry into booking?"
steps: Inquiry Management > QRY-944 menu > Send To Booking
expected: "Are you sure you want to convert this inquiry into a booking?"
actual: "Are you sure want to convert this inquiry into booking?"
description: Missing "you" and article.

title: View Booking shows Booking Status "On Trip" for a pre-booking
pre: B-944 in Pre-Bookings, no vehicle allocated
steps: Booking & Operations > Pre-Bookings > Search Booking Info "B-944"
expected: Status Pre-Booking / Pending confirmation
actual: Booking Status: On Trip; Vehicle Number, Driver N/A; map "Loading vehicle location..."
description: The status shown to staff contradicts the tab the booking sits in.

title: Invoice Summary shows New Base Fare Rs 0.00 and Tax Rs 0.00 while GST is 5% on Rs 8,300
steps: Booking & Operations > Pre-Bookings > Search Booking Info "B-944"
expected: Base fare and 5% tax consistent with the quote (tax Rs 415)
actual: New Base Fare Rs 0.00, Vehicle Costing Rs 8300.00, Tax Rs 0.00
description: Summary amounts are not populated; run 20261112 invoice was Rs 4,725 = 4,500 + 5%, so tax is applied later but shown as 0 here.

title: Edit Booking opens a "Record Advance Payment?" prompt before the edit form
steps: Booking & Operations > Pre-Bookings > Search Booking Info "B-944"
expected: Update Booking form opens
actual: Prompt "Record Advance Payment? Bikash N - Booking B-944" (Yes, Record Advance / No, Not Now / Cancel); form opens only after No, Not Now
description: The advance prompt interrupts unrelated actions (edit, confirm, allocation, dispatch, start, complete, close).

title: "Total Bookings" card counts only Pre-Bookings
steps: Compare "Total Bookings" with Pre-Bookings and Booked counts
expected: Total Bookings = all bookings, or card renamed "Pre-Bookings"
actual: Total Bookings 9-10 = Pre-Bookings count; Booked tab lists 24 bookings
description: Card label misrepresents its count.

title: Closed booking B-932 (trip TP-111, Trip Closed Yes) still listed under Booked; Booked has no Booking ID search
pre: Trip TP-111 closed (Completed Trips: Trip Closed Yes)
expected: Closed booking moves out of Booked (Completed); Booking ID search available as in Pre-Bookings
actual: B-932 still in Booked (row 4); only client/vehicle/date filters
description: Booked mixes active and closed bookings, and staff must page through to find a booking ID.

title: Back to Pre-Bookings toast says "related booking data removed" without stating what is removed
steps: Booked > B-944 menu > Back to Pre-Bookings
expected: Clear message; confirmation dialog warns about data removal
actual: Dialog only asks to move back; toast afterwards "Booking unconfirmed and related booking data removed!" (description/pax/cost were intact)
description: Users are warned of data loss only after the action; the scope of removal is unclear (clarify).

title: Completed tab column "BOOKING ID" shows trip IDs (TP-110)
expected: Booking IDs (B-xxx) or column named Trip ID
actual: BOOKING ID column values TP-110 etc.
description: Column label and values disagree.

title: Upcoming Trips shows a blank TRIP ID (and no Booking ID) for a confirmed booking until trip approval
pre: B-944 confirmed, not yet sent to trip approval
steps: Locate row Bikash N, Local, 20 Nov 2026 12:00 AM (Trip ID blank before approval)
expected: A reference (Booking ID or Trip ID) identifying the row
actual: TRIP ID empty; row identifiable only by client/date; Booking ID visible only inside the advance prompt
description: Also seen for B-932 in run 20261112. Staff cannot tell which booking a row belongs to.

title: Edit Booking from Upcoming Trips does nothing after declining the advance prompt
steps: Locate row Bikash N, Local, 20 Nov 2026 12:00 AM (Trip ID blank before approval)
expected: Update Booking form opens
actual: Prompt closes; no form, page stays on Upcoming Trips
description: From Pre-Bookings the same action opens /update-booking/<uuid>; from Upcoming Trips the edit path is dead.

title: Duty notification shows pickup "@ -" and drop "-" and report time 12:00 AM
steps: Locate row Bikash N, Local, 20 Nov 2026 12:00 AM (Trip ID blank before approval)
Row menu > Send To Trip Approval > Yes
expected: Report time 9:00 AM @ Whitefield, drop Whitefield
actual: "New duty TP-112 - Local, report 12:00 AM @ -, drop -"
description: Locations missing although the trip has Whitefield; same in run 20261112 (TP-111).

title: Over-selection message has spacing/grammar errors

steps: Fleet & Vehicle Management > Fleet & Vehicles > Vehicle Allocation Portal
Trip Approvals & Vehicle Assignment, page 2: TP-112
Allocate > No, Continue to Allocation > Continue
Tick a second 16 Seater Premium Urbania
expected: "The required number of buses is already selected. To select this bus, deselect another one."
actual: "the required buses are already selected.If you want to select this bus then deselect the another one" (lower-case start, missing space, "the another")
description: Copy quality.

title: "Edit Bus Details" opens the allocation-type dialog instead of a bus details form

expected: Form to edit bus details for the trip
actual: "Select the type of allocation you need - Dynamic Allocation - Continue / Cancel"
description: Menu label does not match the action; it re-enters the vehicle allocation flow.

title: Refuel Request does not pre-fill the trip vehicle number

expected: Vehicle No = AR 01 U 8228
actual: Vehicle No empty; "Vehicle No is required" on submit
description: Opened from a specific trip, the form should know the vehicle.

steps: Fleet & Vehicles > Approved & Track Live Trips > Approved Vehicles
Leave all Trip Sheet fields empty
Click Generate Trip Sheet & Mark Vehicle Ready
expected: Required-field messages for each mandatory field
actual: Nothing happens: no message, no toast

Fill all Trip Sheet fields and attach permit
expected: Note marked required on the checklist (or optional and accepted); friendly message on the checklist tab
actual: Next allowed; final submit -> API 400 toast "\"Remarks\" is not allowed to be empty field"
description: Field is called "Add Note" in the UI but "Remarks" in the error; user is on another tab when it fails.

screen: Initiate Vehicle Dispatch > Trip Sheet > Helper

steps: Fleet & Vehicles > Approved & Track Live Trips > Approved Vehicles

description: Observed in run 20261112 on the same form; avoided today by filling Helper.

Fill fields without a permit PDF

description: Raw validation key shown to users.

Start Odometer -50; Fuel Filled 99999; Mileage 0; Opening Km 100 with Start Odometer 200

actual: Next allowed without it (submit later succeeded with it ticked; not tested unticked to avoid dispatching unsafely)
